title: Universal Type-I Radiative / Transport / Seed Coupling Matrix
purpose: Close the gap between 2D schematic intent, 3D embedded inter-layer geometry and 4D time/history-aware operation by compiling field/radiation/transport sources, propagation media, interfaces, receivers, losses, storage and mutual coupling for zero-, single- and multi-seed systems. Distinct physics remain distinct; a common graph contract does not collapse them into one equation.
universal_factorization: Archetype × PrimitiveKernel × VolumetricKernel × InterfaceOperator × ProcessSequence × FunctionalVoxelState × SeedGraph × FieldTransportRegime × MutualCoupling × WitnessEvidence

SG-0.source_rule: No inserted discrete seed. Excitation may be external, environmental, stored-state release, passive thermal emission, mechanical/fluid forcing, or a separately qualified printed active-material process. Passive geometry/material cannot create net active gain or energy.

SG-1.source_rule: Exactly one discrete seed may act as impressed source, receiver, transducer, controller or certified/precision function. Seed package/pads/body are explicit electrical, EM, thermal, mechanical and service boundary regions.
typical_roles: single active die with printed passives
one emitter with printed optics/thermal stack
one sensor seed embedded in passive field-shaping body

SG-N.source_rule: Multiple discrete seeds are compiled as a coupled multiport/multiphysics network. Off-diagonal mutual terms, common return paths, timing, fault domains and common-cause environmental couplings are retained when consequential.

region_roles.rule: Source amplitude/spectrum/state must be attributable; no placeholder source promoted to numeric capability.
Wave/flux/flow path geometry and interfaces are explicit.
Q/resonance requires loss and boundary model or measurement.
Coupling coefficient/matrix term remains symbolic until geometry/material/regime is bound.
Use regime-valid field model; geometric optics is not used for wavelength-scale structures.
Absorption/emissivity/loss tangent/conductivity/etc. must be source-bound or measured.
Shielding is frequency/material/geometry/interface specific; no generic dB claim.
Receiver transfer function and loading are explicit.
Stored energy is domain-specific; electrostatic U=1/2 CV^2 does not generalize to chemistry.
Reference definition is mandatory for matrices/ports and cannot be inferred from visual proximity.

field_transport_regimes.governing: Poisson/Laplace; Q=C·V; U=1/2 V^T C V for linear reference-bound electrostatics
field_transport_regimes.mutual: Maxwell capacitance matrix; retain off-diagonal terms when consequential
field_transport_regimes.regime_gate: electrical length and displacement/current dynamics must permit quasi-static treatment
frequency/material state must justify MQS; eddy/current-distribution effects added when consequential

field_transport_regimes.governing: full Maxwell or validated reduced near-field model
field_transport_regimes.mutual: multiport Z/Y/S or field-derived coupling; electric and magnetic coupling both allowed
field_transport_regimes.regime_gate: near-field/far-field regime declared from source size, wavelength, separation and intended observable; no universal distance threshold forced across all radiators

field_transport_regimes.governing: full-wave Maxwell; radiated power/pattern/gain only from validated solve or measurement
field_transport_regimes.topology: radiator + finite body + environment + observation region
field_transport_regimes.mutual: array/seed interactions through full-wave multiport/field solution
field_transport_regimes.regime_gate: far-field approximation must be valid for source aperture/geometry/wavelength and observation distance

field_transport_regimes.governing: ray/eikonal when scale permits; wave/FDTD/FEM/transfer matrix when wavelength-scale behavior matters
field_transport_regimes.regime_gate: material optical constants and wavelength/geometry scale bound

field_transport_regimes.governing: Stefan-Boltzmann/view-factor/radiosity network under declared gray/diffuse assumptions; otherwise spectral radiative transfer
field_transport_regimes.topology: radiating surfaces + view geometry + participating medium if any
field_transport_regimes.regime_gate: emissivity/spectral state/view factors/environment must be attributable

field_transport_regimes.mutual: mechanical/acoustic impedance and modal coupling matrix
field_transport_regimes.regime_gate: medium properties, boundary conditions and frequency range attributable

field_transport_regimes.governing: continuity/Navier-Stokes or validated reduced hydraulic network
field_transport_regimes.mutual: shared pressure/flow network and compliant-volume coupling
field_transport_regimes.regime_gate: laminar/turbulent/compressible/rarefied regime selected from attributable state

field_transport_regimes.governing: Fick/reaction-diffusion/permeation model only in validated regime
field_transport_regimes.regime_gate: diffusivity/solubility/reaction data and temperature/material state attributable

field_transport_regimes.governing: Nernst/Butler-Volmer/transport only where chemistry and regime are qualified
field_transport_regimes.regime_gate: exact chemistry/material/process/state required; no generic battery inference

field_transport_regimes.governing: attenuation only in valid simple regime; consequential cases require transport/Monte-Carlo or measured qualification
field_transport_regimes.topology: source spectrum + shield layers + gaps + sensitive volumes
field_transport_regimes.regime_gate: particle/photon spectrum, materials, geometry and environment attributable

field_transport_regimes.governing: rigid/flexible-body dynamics and contact as applicable
field_transport_regimes.regime_gate: mass properties and motion/load environment attributable

linearity_and_energy_rules.linear_superposition: Allowed only inside a validated linear time-invariant or locally linear regime. Then response may be assembled from external plus seed-source contributions and mutual matrix terms.
linearity_and_energy_rules.nonlinear_rule: If constitutive properties, geometry, switching, saturation, chemistry, temperature, deformation, control or history makes the response materially nonlinear/time-varying, superposition is invalid and the coupled state must be solved.
linearity_and_energy_rules.passivity: For passive SG-0 regions, delivered output energy cannot exceed external input plus released stored energy within declared uncertainty. Apparent gain triggers HOLD for source/measurement/model review.
linearity_and_energy_rules.reciprocity: Reciprocity may be used only when material/system conditions support it; active, magnetically biased, time-varying, nonlinear or nonreciprocal media are not forced reciprocal.
linearity_and_energy_rules.causality: State/output at time t depends only on admissible current/past inputs/state; fitted models that violate causal/energy constraints remain candidate-only.
linearity_and_energy_rules.balance: Every solve/witness declares input, stored, dissipated/converted and exported energy/power channels for consequential domains.

capacitance_closure.scalar_parallel_plate: C=epsilon0*epsilon_r*A/d only when the uniform-field parallel-plate approximation and actual thickness/material state are valid.
capacitance_closure.layered_1d: For uniform series dielectric layers over common area: C/A = epsilon0 / sum_i(d_i/epsilon_ri). Interfaces/voids/adhesives become explicit layers when consequential.
capacitance_closure.multi_conductor: For arbitrary 3D conductors use a reference-bound Maxwell capacitance matrix Q=C·V rather than a single scalar. Connectivity then maps the matrix to the desired port capacitance.
capacitance_closure.sensitivity: For ideal C proportional to epsilon*A/d, small perturbations satisfy dC/C approximately d(epsilon)/epsilon + dA/A - dd/d; uncertainty uses covariance when inputs are correlated.

source_bound_comparator.basis: current DuPont Kapton HN source-bound candidate record at 1 kHz; engineering comparator only

capacitance_closure.discrepancy_gate: Any stored capacitance density attached to a nominal thickness label must reproduce from its stated epsilon_r and actual/source thickness. If not, retain HOLD until the actual gauge/thickness basis is reconciled; do not silently relabel arithmetic.
exclusions: no fringe/fixture/process correction unless modeled or measured

interlayer_edge_contract.rule: No physical adjacency is ideal or invisible. A consequential transfer, reflection, return path, leakage, contact, coupling or damage mechanism that is not attributable remains HOLD rather than being set to zero.
typed_edge_rules: Each edge instance binds one exact field_transport_regime ID; compound aliases are not accepted as solved edge provenance.
process_direction is explicit region_from->region_to; the reverse direction is a separate edge with its own damage, preservation, witness and evidence state.
predecessor_damage_gate and preservation_action are mandatory even when the value is an attributable NONE/NOT_REQUIRED result.
evidence_state and authority are explicit; geometry adjacency alone cannot promote SOURCE_BOUND/ARCHITECTURE state to SOLVED, MEASURED, QUALIFIED or executable.
SOLVED/MEASURED edge use requires source-bound model/measurement/result provenance at the normal-form coupling layer.

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: electrical conduction/contact
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: normal/tangential current and potential relation from attributable conductor/contact state
interlayer_transfer_basis.return_block: contact resistance, isolation, leakage or open boundary explicit
interlayer_transfer_basis.mutual: R/contact-R plus C/L parasitics as geometry requires

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: dielectric displacement/capacitive
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: D-normal/E-tangential boundary relation; Q=C·V for arbitrary multi-conductor geometry
interlayer_transfer_basis.return_block: dielectric/interface polarization, leakage and shields explicit
interlayer_transfer_basis.mutual: Maxwell capacitance matrix including seed/package electrodes
interlayer_transfer_basis.witness: calibrated C/complex impedance plus exact geometry/material state

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: magnetic flux/inductive
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: B/H boundary relation and flux linkage Phi=L·I
interlayer_transfer_basis.mutual: self/mutual L, partial inductance, DCR and parasitic C
interlayer_transfer_basis.witness: L/Q/coupling/field measurement in declared frequency regime

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: RF electromagnetic wave
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: full-wave Maxwell/S-Z-Y or RLGC only when distributed-line assumptions hold
interlayer_transfer_basis.return_block: reflection, transmission, radiation, absorption, aperture/seam leakage and shield return explicit
interlayer_transfer_basis.mutual: S-matrix/coupled ports/near-field seed susceptibility and package interconnect
interlayer_transfer_basis.witness: VNA/field/antenna readback with near/far regime declared

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: optical/photonic wave
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: Fresnel/Snell or wave/FDTD/FEM only in the applicable interface/scale regime
interlayer_transfer_basis.return_block: reflection, refraction, scattering, absorption and polarization conversion explicit

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: thermal conduction/contact
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: heat-flux/temperature relation with attributable conductivity/contact resistance
interlayer_transfer_basis.return_block: thermal break/interface resistance and anisotropy explicit
interlayer_transfer_basis.mutual: thermal conductance/capacitance network or field model

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: thermal surface radiation
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: radiosity/view-factor model; epsilon*sigma*A*F*(T1^4-T2^4) only under valid gray/diffuse assumptions
interlayer_transfer_basis.return_block: emissivity, reflection, occlusion and view factors explicit

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: mechanical traction/compliance
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: traction/displacement/velocity compatibility or contact law appropriate to bond/contact
interlayer_transfer_basis.return_block: slip, gap, preload, damping and compliance explicit

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: acoustic/elastic wave
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: pressure/velocity or stress/particle-velocity continuity by medium/interface
interlayer_transfer_basis.return_block: impedance mismatch, reflection, transmission and damping explicit

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: fluid/gas/species transport
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: mass/momentum/species flux with interface/seal/porous law appropriate to regime
interlayer_transfer_basis.return_block: seal resistance, valve state, permeation/leak and capillary effects explicit

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: chemical/electrochemical/ionic
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: species/electrochemical flux only from validated chemistry and constitutive model

interlayer_transfer_basis.name: ionizing radiation transport
interlayer_transfer_basis.transfer: attenuation/transport/deposition bound to spectrum, material and geometry; transport/Monte-Carlo or measurement for consequential cases
interlayer_transfer_basis.return_block: scattering, secondary production, shielding shadowing and gaps explicit
interlayer_transfer_basis.mutual: common-mode dose/upset/aging across seed and polymer volumes
interlayer_transfer_basis.witness: source/spectrum-bound dosimetry or qualified transport model

sequence_and_interlayer_rules: A 2D schematic/netlist fixes logical intended connectivity only.
The 3D region graph fixes actual adjacency, overlap, separation, orientation, return/reference paths, cavities and seed package boundaries.
Every X→Y process edge checks predecessor temperature, atmosphere, solvent/chemistry, pressure, radiation/light, mechanical and contamination damage envelopes.
SO-ENCAPSULATE may preserve a completed oxygen/moisture/chemical-sensitive region before incompatible later processing when a qualified barrier/process exists.
Field voids and cavities are first-class regions; void geometry may shape fields/thermal/fluid/mechanical behavior but is never an energy source.
Multiple seed sources may share a body only after mutual coupling, thermal path, power/reference integrity, fault containment and service constraints are compiled.
Any consequential geometry/material/process/boundary revision invalidates stale numeric matrices and requires solve/readback refresh.
Insert a seed only when all remaining process steps fit its exact package/process envelope or a qualified preservation/encapsulation barrier isolates it.
Do not close cavities/channels/voids before required dimensional, cleanliness, leak or internal-interface witness is complete.
Preserve service, metrology, discharge/isolation, thermal relief, pressure relief and safe-state paths as explicit functional regions.
Process history is part of 4D state: cure, anneal, magnetize/polarize, fill/evacuate/seal, preload and configuration events are not silent metadata.

SG0: self/mutual R/C/L or relevant field/transport witness

build_ready_gate: exact material/seed source and lot/passport where physical material is used
field/transport regime selected with model-validity evidence
required self/mutual matrix terms solved or measured
directional process sequence passes predecessor-damage checks
engineering_boundaries: This matrix is a compiler/evidence contract, not proof that every combination is manufacturable.
No universal radiation equation exists across RF, optics, thermal radiation, acoustics and ionizing transport.
Near-field electromagnetic coupling and far-field radiation are distinct regimes.
A seed supplies only its warranted function; surrounding geometry does not inherit seed certification/rating.
SG-0 does not imply active logic or self-powering; external interrogation/environmental excitation may be required.
Radiative/transport coupling can be deliberately functional or parasitic; both enter the same graph.
Physical execution remains NOT_RUN until separately authorized and evidenced.
